name: gitguru
description: Two Claude Code skills: /explain-diff analyzes git diffs and PRs with risk scoring, /repo-onboard generates architecture docs and Mermaid flow diagrams for new developers.
author: NabeelShaikh08

skills.name: explain-diff
skills.description: Analyzes git diffs and GitHub PRs — plain English summary, risk level (Low/Medium/High), what could break, and specific test cases to write.

requires.gh: optional — needed for PR number support

skills.name: repo-onboard
skills.description: Generates ARCHITECTURE.md, FLOW.md (with Mermaid diagrams), QUICKSTART.md, and KEY_FILES.md to help new developers understand any codebase.

watch-mode.description: Chokidar-based file watcher that auto-runs /explain-diff every time you save a file.
watch-mode.setup: cd watch && npm install && node watch.js
